negative_snippets:
Extremely Disappointing Stay – Very Poor Hygiene & Mismanagement

I had a terrible experience at this hotel, and I feel it's important to share so others don’t go through the same.

I had booked this hotel through Agoda, but when I reached the property, the staff claimed that my booking was not confirmed. After a lot of back-and-forth, they finally gave me a room but charged me an extra ₹300 in the name of taxes, which felt completely unfair and suspicious.

Despite telling the staff 4–5 times, they never changed the dirty bedsheets.

The bathrooms were filthy – not just in my room but also the common ones I checked.

And the worst part – cockroaches were coming out of the bed! That was absolutely disgusting and unacceptable.

Overall, it was a horrible stay. I would strongly advise avoiding this hotel unless they seriously fix their cleanliness, honesty, and customer service.
